What We Offer

Our Services

From design to installation and ongoing maintenance — we transform your outdoor spaces into living masterpieces.

🌳

Landscape Design

Complete garden design and installation including trees, shrubs, plants, and hardscaping for villas and commercial properties.

🌺

Bougainvillea Specialists

Expert planting and shaping of colorful bougainvillea in all varieties — pink, yellow, red, orange, white, and mixed.

🌿

Artificial Grass

Premium artificial turf installation for gardens, rooftops, and play areas — lush, durable, and water-saving.

✂️

Garden Maintenance

Regular trimming, pruning, watering, fertilising, and plant care to keep your garden healthy and beautiful all year.

🏡

Entrance & Patio Design

Beautiful potted plant arrangements and entrance landscaping to create stunning first impressions.

🌱

Rooftop & Balcony Gardens

Specialised green solutions for rooftop terraces and balconies including planter boxes and climbing plants.

About Us

Bringing Nature to Your Home

Muhammad Bachal — Dubai's Trusted Landscaping & Gardening Experts

Muhammad Bachal is a leading landscape and gardening company based in Dubai, UAE. With years of hands-on experience, we create and maintain stunning green spaces for villas, townhouses, commercial properties, and rooftops across the UAE.

Our team specialises in bougainvillea cultivation, artificial grass installation, complete garden design, and year-round maintenance services tailored to the unique climate of Dubai.
